title: ID5 halogen-neighborhood solubility triage
objective: Explore a narrow single-halogen substitution neighborhood around the crystallographic ID5 ligand from PDB 1T40 and prioritize structurally valid, in-domain candidates by the frozen aqueous-solubility model for further computational review.

triage.within_eligible_review_order: higher frozen-model predicted aqueous logS first

interpretation_boundaries: Generated analogs are E0_HEURISTIC candidate structures, not evidence of activity.
Solubility predictions are E1_ML estimates and preserve the frozen ESOL/AqSolDB applicability-domain limits.
No docking is executed automatically in MOLDISC-001 v1.
If analog docking is later requested against the 1T40 holo receptor, it must declare NON_COGNATE_HOLO_CROSSDOCKING and inherit the partially validated docking capability boundary.
This program does not establish binding affinity, potency, efficacy, safety, synthesizability or clinical value.
